items.exampleEn: The bus is late as usual.
The wind is blowing strongly today.
The ice on the lake is very smooth.
Only the inner part of the castle is open.
items.exampleZh: 只有城堡的內部開放參觀。

items.exampleEn: Unlike my brother, I love books.
items.exampleZh: 和哥哥不一樣，我愛看書。

items.exampleEn: The old wooden bridge is closed.

items.sentenceEn: Please close the door quietly. The baby is sleeping.
items.sentenceZh: 請輕輕關門，寶寶在睡覺。

items.audioEn: I'll meet you at the usual place at seven.
items.audioZh: 我七點在老地方跟你碰面。
options: At the gate of the school

items.sentenceEn: This road is new and very smooth.
items.sentenceZh: 這條路是新的，非常平順。

items.sentenceEn: I strongly agree with your idea.

items.stemEn: My grandfather made this ____ chair from an old tree.
items.stemZh: 我爺爺用一棵老樹做了這張木椅。

items.stemEn: She keeps her money in the ____ pocket of her jacket.
items.stemZh: 她把錢放在外套的內側口袋裡。

items.passageEn: My grandmother keeps two old boxes in a drawer. One box is wooden and heavy. Unlike the wooden box, the other one is silver and light. In the wooden box, there is a smooth stone from the beach. In the inner part of the silver box, she keeps her old letters. Last night, as usual, she opened it quietly and read a letter to me. "I strongly believe old things have stories," she said.
items.passageZh: 我奶奶在抽屜裡收著兩個舊盒子。一個是木頭做的，很重；和木盒子不一樣，另一個是銀的，很輕。木盒子裡有一顆海邊撿來的光滑石頭。銀盒子的內層放著她的舊信件。昨晚，她像平常一樣輕輕地掀開盒子，讀了一封信給我聽。她說：「我深信舊東西都有故事。」

questions.questionZh: 奶奶把舊信件放在哪裡？

items.promptZh: 這張桌子摸起來很光滑。

items.instructionZh: 用 usual 造一個句子，說說你平常的習慣，或今天和平常不一樣的事。
referenceEn: I got up earlier than usual today.
As usual, I had rice for lunch.
rubricZh: usual 常用在 as usual、than usual（例如 earlier than usual）
時態配合句意（例如 got up、had）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：My brother and I are unlike 不自然：unlike 作敘述形容詞（be unlike）極少用且多需接受詞，現代英文應寫 My brother and I are very different 或 Unlike my brother, I love books.；建議改用介系詞用法 unlike＋名詞。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "Unlike my brother, I love books."（原 "My brother and I are unlike: he loves sports, and I love books."）；依已裁「同義換詞性可用」改介系詞用法

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：The boxes are very unlike. 文法不道地（unlike 不這樣單獨作補語並受 very 修飾），應為 The boxes are very different / The two boxes are unlike each other。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "My grandmother keeps two old boxes in a drawer. One box is wooden and heavy. Unlike the wooden box, the other one is silver and light. In the wooden box, there is a smooth stone from the beach. In the inner part of the silver box, she keeps her old letters. Last night, as usual, she opened it quietly and read a letter to me. \"I strongly believe old things have stories,\" she said."（原 "My grandmother keeps two old boxes in a drawer. The boxes are very unlike. One is wooden and heavy, and the other is silver and light. In the wooden box, there is a smooth stone from the beach. In the inner part of the silver box, she keeps her old letters. Last night, as usual, she opened it quietly and read a letter to me. \"I strongly believe old things have stories,\" she said."）
